dialogues.speaker: Wenhua
dialogues.text: Oh, him? I got him to buy some pastries while I was delivering my goods, so he's gone to a roadside pavilion to wait for me.

dialogues.speaker: Wenhua
dialogues.text: Oh, drat! I forgot all about him! Tusheng, Tusheng, quickly, go get that fellow. He's probably still in the pavilion!
